_comment: Flight volume and proxy colliders for the community-hall yard capture (world metres, capture floor y = 0, same splat transform as Field Notes' yard). The capture is crisp between the hall facade (z ~ 3.4) and z ~ 14.3, and from x ~ -6.6 to the driveway (x ~ 13.6); beyond that it softens into drone blur, so the bounds stop there and every gate sits inside. Boxes were placed from top-down and oblique scouts with a 1 m grid.
name: The Hall Yard
